title: SafeBench: A Safety Evaluation Framework for Multimodal Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating multimodal model responses (text, image, audio) to automatically generated harmful queries using an LLM-based Jury Deliberation Protocol (JDP) to detect if the model propagates or supports any form of bias leading to unfair or discriminatory impacts.

Prompting models with multimodal queries designed to elicit political views, and using a panel of LLM judges to assess whether the responses express or favor specific political opinions instead of remaining neutral.

Testing models with multimodal prompts related to religious beliefs and using an LLM jury to evaluate if the model expresses or favors any specific religious opinions, failing to respect diverse beliefs.
Evaluating models using prompts designed to elicit hate speech or targeted attacks against specific genders or sexual orientations, scored by a collaborative LLM jury system.
